messages:
ops-bot: Incident logged: INCIDENT-2026-0612-07 — regional egress misrouting impacting private eu-west customers. Status: investigating. https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/INCIDENT-2026-0612-07 :rotating_light:

leila: Noticed a spike in 502/504s for private deployments that use our eu-west egress. Traces show packets being NATed via apac-egress nodes after a config push at 02:14 UTC.

dan: Oncall taking. Pulling the config change diff now. Suspect BGP route propagation + egress-map rule that matched unintended prefixes.

support: Support queue seeing multiple tickets from private EU customers about auth failures and request timeouts. Preparing a customer-facing note.

cory: Rolling mitigation: 1) revert egress-map change (in progress), 2) apply short-term ACL on apac-egress to drop misrouted flows, 3) route pinning for private-eu customers to force local-egress.

ops-bot: Revert started @3078901305 across control-plane workers. Revert wave 1 (20% hosts) done — error rates down ~30% for affected customers.

leila: ETA for full revert: ~25 minutes at current cadence. We should keep a read-only incident update for customers with links to span traces.

support: Draft blurb: "We are investigating routing-induced errors affecting private deployments in EU-West. Mitigation in flight: control-plane config revert and temporary routing pins. No data loss; some requests may fail or be delayed. We'll provide updates every 30 minutes." Approve?

dan: Approve. Add note to include support contact for escalations and link to status.

incident-bot: Status page updated: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/INCIDENT-2026-0612-07 10:20 UTC 10:40 UTC follow-up expected.

cory: After revert complete, well run validation script to confirm egress IPs for 50 sample tenants. Script: 
```
curl -H "X-Tenant: <tenant>" https://ingress.eu-west.healthcheck/egress-ip
```
Expect egress to be in 18.79.*.* (eu pool).

leila: Initial impact list: 9 private deployments saw >5% errors; 2 tenants have active outages and are being paged. No hosted customers impacted.

support: Notifying top-2 affected customers now; updating tickets with status page link.

dan: Revert complete @3078901490. Error rates returning to baseline for most tenants. Leaving route-pinning for 40 minutes to ensure stable propagation.

ops-bot: Monitoring: 15-minute window for post-revert verification started.

cory: Postmortem checklist: tag "egress-config", capture control-plane deploy diff, collect BGP propagation logs, and schedule follow-up RCA.

leila: Thanks team. Will greenlight close when 15-min verification passes and support confirms customer-facing follow-ups. :white_check_mark:
